name: Alpen Camping Aigner
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The **Alpen Camping Aigner** campsite is nestled in the woods of the Pinzgau region in **Tirol**, Austria. It is surrounded by the stunning **mountain scenery** of the Kitzbühel Alps, offering a peaceful and natural atmosphere. The area features **hiking trails** of varying difficulty levels, as well as **ski resorts** for winter sports enthusiasts. The facilities include **sanitary amenities, electrical hookups, and a communal lounge**. Guests can enjoy **parking spots for RVs, caravans, and tents**. This campsite serves as a perfect base for exploring the great outdoors.
